name: Edinburg Tree Lighting Ceremony at Promenade Park Amphitheater
when_note: City staff host activities from 6 to 9 pm, and the tree lights at 6:30 pm.
paras: The City of Edinburg lights its official Christmas tree on Thursday, December 3, 2026, at the Promenade Park Amphitheater, 212 W. McIntyre. The ceremony is at 6:30 pm, and city staff host activities from 6 to 9 pm.

The city lists live music, games, a petting zoo, food vendors and pictures with Santa. The tree lighting kicks off a two-day celebration, and the Night of Lights Parade follows the next evening on Closner Boulevard.
tip: Check the city's flyer for the full activity list before you go.

name: Edinburg Night of Lights Parade
paras: The Edinburg Chamber of Commerce presents the Night of Lights Parade on Friday, December 4, 2026, starting at 7 pm along Closner Boulevard in downtown Edinburg. This year's theme is Christmas in the Toy Box.

The city says local organizations build the floats, and the theme draws on childhood favorites. The parade is the second night of a two-day holiday celebration that begins with the tree lighting on December 3.
tip: Santa and Sirens runs the same evening at Promenade Park Amphitheater, so families can plan around both.

name: Santa and Sirens at Promenade Park Amphitheater
paras: The Edinburg Fire Department hosts Santa and Sirens on Friday, December 4, 2026, from 6 to 10 pm at the Promenade Park Amphitheater. The city describes it as the department's Firestoppers Festival, rescheduled from October.
The festival has festive rides, a petting zoo, carolers and educational activities on fire prevention, all at the amphitheater.
tip: The Night of Lights Parade starts at 7 pm the same night on Closner Boulevard.

name: Mayor's Annual Christmas Tree Lighting at Leo Pena Placita Park
address: Leo Pena Placita Park, Mission, TX 78572
paras: The City of Mission holds the Mayor's Annual Christmas Tree Lighting on Friday, December 4, 2026, from 6 to 9 pm at Leo Pena Placita Park. The tree lights at 6:30 pm.
The city lists a visit with Santa, arts and crafts, student performances, food vendors, hot cocoa, sweet treats and bike raffles throughout the evening.
tip: Parks and Recreation takes questions about the event at 956-580-8760.

name: Winter Wonderland in Downtown Pharr
paras: The City of Pharr hosts Winter Wonderland 2026 in downtown Pharr on Friday, December 4, from 6 to 10:30 pm, at 118 S. Cage Blvd. The annual Christmas Tree Lighting Ceremony is at 7 pm.
The city lists festive entertainment, local shopping and holiday treats, and files the event under children's events.
tip: Pharr's Christmas Night at the Library follows on December 15 for another family evening.

name: Annual Christmas Night at the Library at Pharr Memorial Library
when_note: Photos with Santa begin at 5 pm.
paras: Pharr Memorial Library holds its Annual Christmas Night at the Library on Tuesday, December 15, 2026, at 121 E. Cherokee Ave. The program starts at 6 pm, and photos with Santa begin at 5 pm.

The city lists storytime, live dance performances, hot chocolate and cookies, children's activities, a book giveaway and a toy raffle. The event is filed under children's events on the city's calendar.
tip: Arrive by 5 pm if you want a photo with Santa before the 6 pm program.
